name: LEGIT
description: Trust-check any x402 merchant or agent address on Algorand, Base, Solana, or 17 other chains before routing a payment: real-time grades (A+ to F) and scores (0-100) built from live uptime, response latency, and payment coherence measurements, not self-reported data. Run as a pre-payment trust check: call GET /v1/check/{address} before any x402 payment to an address you have not paid before. Created by GONNA.

settling.rule: real demand observed (external 30d calls/payers or settled payments); probed every cycle

dormant.rule: last success 7-30 days ago, or no success in retained history and first seen under 30 days ago

dead.rule: no successful measurement in 30+ days, or no success ever and first seen 30+ days ago

testnet.rule: testnet/sepolia/devnet networks are excluded from scheduled probing

probing.first_measurement: never-probed merchants are not tiered: the first-measurement reserve keeps them always due
probing.backstop: an explicit user request (/v1/check, /v1/report, /v1/compare, /v1/arena) for a tracked merchant stale for its tier queues one out-of-turn probe via a ProbeRequest row, honored once
